newsitem.title: UK: UK Labour lead widens four points to 21 pct - poll.
newsitem.headline: UK Labour lead widens four points to 21 pct - poll.

text.p: The opposition Labour party's opinion poll lead over the ruling Conservatives has widened four points to 21 points in the latest MORI poll, a spokesman for Britain's Times newspaper said on Wednesday.
The poll for Thursday's Times is a reversal of a poll in Wednesday's Guardian newspaper which showed Labour's lead had plummeted to five points from 14.
The MORI poll put support for Labour at 48 percent, down one point from a week ago, while Conservative support was down five points at 27 percent.
The Liberal Democrats gained five points to 17 percent.

A Gallup poll for Thursday's Channel Four television news showed Labour down four points from a fortnight ago at 19 points and, with the MORI survey, seemed to confirm that the ICM poll in the Guardian was a freak.
Labour has otherwise maintained a double-digit lead in opinion polls for at least the last 18 months. It needs a 4.3 percent swing to win the May 1 election.
